sections.text: So this one makes uploads retry when the network hiccups, instead of failing the whole batch on the first error. Three tries, with a growing pause between them.
Everything lives in the uploader. It gets a retry loop and a setting for how many attempts to allow.
The interesting bit is the loop. It only retries timeouts and server errors, and it adds a little randomness to the wait so clients don't all come back at once.
